question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Propitiate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Enrage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Propitiate"** means to win or regain the favor of a god, spirit, or person by doing something that pleases them. (शांत करना, प्रसन्न करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The villagers offered sacrifices to propitiate the angry gods.
 
 
• **"Enrage"** is the antonym of "Propitiate" and means to make someone extremely angry or infuriate them. (क्रोधित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** His rude comments enrage everyone in the meeting.
